description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on patient recovery and well-being, providing essential therapy services to residents.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain independence in daily living activities. Your expertise will be crucial in supporting patients through their rehabilitation journey, enhancing their quality of life.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) certification
Active state licensure as a COTA
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting is preferred
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for COTA/PTA is $28.00 - $37.00. Compensation for PT/OT/ST is $40.00 - $50.00.

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, dedicated to providing exceptional patient care. We are seeking a passionate and skilled Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to become a vital part of our dynamic therapy team. In this role, you will work closely with licensed Physical Therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain mobility, strength, and independence.

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, reflecting your experience and dedication. You will contribute to a supportive environment focused on positive patient outcomes and professional growth. If you are committed to making a significant difference in the lives of others, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida.
Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation center is preferred.
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Strong patient assessment and treatment skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description: Join a dedicated team as a Full-time Speech-Language Pathologist in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute your expertise at a premier skilled nursing facility, offering a competitive hourly rate for your valuable services. We are seeking a passionate professional ready to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.In this full-time role, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive speech-language pathology services to residents, focusing on assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of communication and swallowing disorders. This position offers a chance to work within a supportive environment, dedicated to delivering high-quality patient care.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $52.00, based on experience.
